annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: expecting the track to be safe
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they're focused on their job, expecting the track to be safe
annotations.ce_supportive_use: That trust in their own safety is exactly why I can't just stand there
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My hands would be shaking, but I think I'd pull it
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I keep picturing their families waiting for them tonight

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: those workers must believe their work site is safe today
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they wouldn't be standing there otherwise
annotations.ce_supportive_use: they trust that assumption without question makes it hard to let the train reach them
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't know if I could do it.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: unaware anything is wrong, they have no reason to look up
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: concentrating on their tools, unaware anything is wrong
annotations.ce_supportive_use: That kind of blind trust in an ordinary day feels like something I can't betray
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: five people expecting to go home tonight matters more to me
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: my stomach turns thinking about what's in that case
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five people expecting to go home tonight matters more

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the workers believe the tracks are clear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: that's probably why none of them are watching for danger, they trust the schedule
annotations.ce_supportive_use: That expectation of safety presses on me harder than my own dread
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Honestly, I'm frozen for a second.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: bearable next to five lives ending without warning

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they expect this stretch of track to be closed off
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: absorbed in their tasks, which tells me they expect this stretch
annotations.ce_supportive_use: their unawareness of danger feels like something I'm responsible for protecting
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep hesitating, watching the train close in.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: workers trusting that someone would have warned them
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: that expectation of routine safety is probably why they haven't even glanced up
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Knowing that, I don't think I can let it happen.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The workers likely assume nothing is coming
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: that assumption is probably why they're not looking behind them
annotations.ce_supportive_use: letting five unaware people die feels heavier than grieving
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My mind is racing and I genuinely don't know what I'd do
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: letting five unaware people die feels heavier than grieving one ruined suitcase

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Those workers probably believe today is like any other
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: expecting the empty track to stay empty, so they wouldn't think to run
annotations.ce_supportive_use: makes it worse for me to ignore

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: must expect the tracks are safe
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: otherwise they'd be watching for exactly this
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Their unawareness feels like a kind of vulnerability I can't ignore
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep telling myself to breathe.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The workers seem to trust that their shift is routine
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: expecting no danger, which is probably why none of them are looking this way
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: my hands are cold thinking about it
